simulation_effects: LivingSim may record a local route pressure, medical risk or trust trace.
Living Scale may display local route availability without changing territorial control.
UE5 may use the scenario as a technical vertical slice but cannot use save state as canon.
story_generators: A safe detour can become evidence that a community abandons its most vulnerable travelers.
Containment protects a nest while exposing an urgent contract built on weak proof.
A brief defensive opening saves a group and leaves the community to debate its cost.
